text.text: Documentation for the components people build with. One home for tokens, components and rules. Start from the foundations, find a component, and check its status before using it.
Card 1.8.0: radius now reads from radius-card.
Tooltip deprecated; use the Popover pattern.
Principles settle arguments. When two good ideas collide in a review, the principle higher on this list wins.
Clear before clever: every screen has one obvious next step.
Consistent: the same thing looks and acts the same everywhere.
Accessible by default: contrast, focus and keyboard are part of done.
If a component needs a special case, the system is missing a variant.
Clear before clever: if a new user cannot tell what to press, the component is not finished.
Consistent: before adding a variant, look for the existing one that almost fits.
Accessible by default: contrast, focus order and keyboard use are checked in the same review as the look.
Flexible: a hard-coded value in a component is a missing token.
Foundations are the smallest agreed pieces. Everything else is made from them, so a change here moves the whole system.
Corner radius and elevation follow the same rules as colour: use a named token, never a pixel value. The tokens table above lists them under Radius and Shadow.
